title: I self-published my dream diary...
content: I'm giving up my anonymity here on The Mallworld. In 2020, I unknowingly became somewhat adjacent to this community - my first Lucid experience that I documented, was inside a mall. It wasn't after I decided to use reddit for dreams, instead of Pokemon Go and UFO and the Paranormal almost a year ago, is when I found this group. The book was originally from the first of three different blogs I maintained on Blogger. Sharing my experiences then (back in 20') was a good way to deal with the constant sleep interruptions that were happening, causing me to remember at least three dreams every night. I still have more documented dreams leading right up to December of 24'. This book is entirely self-published and edited by me (I can't afford real help) so there are still some questionable sentences and structure needing to be polished. The book takes place in 2019, 2020-2022, well before I found out about The Mall World. I can confidently say that this body of work is not bound for a Pulitzer prize, and the price may bee too steep for some people. I decided to add a Kindle version, this is a plus for anyone with Kindle Unlimited (It's Free)
